features.preprocessing: No fitted transforms; preserve NaN, convert infinities to NaN.

label.target: pandas average rank(pct=True) - 0.5 within eligible signal-day members
label.missing_endpoint: exclude the label, never replace with zero

portfolio.rank_order: descending predicted score, then ascending symbol for ties
portfolio.candidate_filter: signal-day conditional member with finite prediction and finite close
portfolio.execution: freeze units at signal close, execute next session open
portfolio.quarter_boundary: continue holdings; next scheduled rebalance uses the new model
portfolio.control: all conditional members, same dates, initial cash and costs

primary_comparison: base-cost model portfolio versus base-cost equal weight, on 2023-07-03 through 2023-12-29
interpretation: 2023 aggregate and daily equal-weight outcomes were already inspected; all model results here are development diagnostics, not a blind final test.
The half-year evaluation allows 60 prior sessions for Alpha158 followed by approximately one quarter of initial training; it is not a substitute for the planned multi-year walk-forward study.
Quarterly expanding-window fitting is fixed before model results. Q4 may use matured Q3 labels under this predetermined schedule.
No tuning or selection among models, seeds, stock counts or cost rules after observing this run. Keep negative results.
Source-native prices and volumes are uncertified adjustment/normalization candidates; no claim of formal historical availability or adjustment accuracy.
All equal-weight diagnostic execution limitations also apply: fractional adjusted units, incomplete ST/limit/capacity/rights modeling, no official index benchmark.
Evaluate return, excess versus matched equal weight, drawdown, turnover, costs and IC; an improvement can still lose money and does not establish a profitable strategy.
